results.title: Geological and Environmental Management Services
results.description: GEMS is an environmental and biodiversity consultancy organization working on biodiversity assessment, ecosystem management, environmental research, and GIS-based biodiversity information management. Its work includes the collection, analysis, documentation, and dissemination of biodiversity data, particularly in Pakistan. GEMS aims to contribute reliable biodiversity occurrence, ecological, and spatial datasets to support research, conservation planning, environmental assessment, and evidence-based biodiversity management.

results.title: Wildlife Insights
results.description: Wildlife Insights is a global collaborative platform dedicated to making biodiversity monitoring data open, actionable, and accessible to support science, conservation, and evidence-based decision-making worldwide. In direct alignment with GBIF’s mission to mobilize biodiversity data globally, Wildlife Insights acts as a core infrastructure for aggregating, standardizing, and sharing camera trap data from global monitoring initiatives.

comments.content:
Is associated with a GBIF-funded project: no


Expects to publish:


 - Sampling event data


Expected data content:

> Wildlife Insights is a global platform for managing, analyzing, and sharing camera trap data. We plan to publish biodiversity data from Wildlife Insights projects once the data becomes public after the applicable embargo period expires, except where data is published separately by the data provider or belongs to a project that remains private. The datasets primarily consist of camera trap sampling events, including deployments, locations, dates and sampling information, together with associated wildlife observations and species identifications derived from camera trap images. Data will be transformed from the Wildlife Insights data model into CamtrapDP format and published to GBIF through the Integrated Publishing Toolkit (IPT) service currently being set up and operated by Wildlife Insights.
